summary: Oni entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Oni
entries.definitive_edition: Original Windows PC release with compatibility fixes documented

emulation.notes: Use native Windows compatibility fixes; PS2 emulation only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC release with documented fixes

primary.version: Original PC release with compatibility fixes / Anniversary Edition documented if used
primary.why: Oni has no sourced current storefront route, and the Windows/Mac originals are the main high-fidelity capture routes. The PS2 version is useful for comparison, but the PC route preserves the original action/shooter controls with better capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PC copy with compatibility fixes. Record OS, patch/fix state, resolution, input device, difficulty, level, save route, mod/Anniversary Edition state, and whether PS2 or Mac versions were compared.

secondary.why: Mac is part of the original release family but less convenient for capture.
PC has stronger capture and control flexibility.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record mod/Anniversary Edition state and do not treat it as a stock original build.
